SCGSim prepares a geometry and solver request, then resolves the returned results with their units and model identity. Choose the quantity you need, then follow that tutorial’s environment steps to prepare its tools.

## Choose a simulation {#getting-started}

| Goal | Notebook | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Capacitance | [Palace Electrostatic or AEDT Q3D](tutorials/capacitance.qmd) | Labeled conductor capacitance matrix |
| Resonant modes | [HFSS Eigenmode tutorial](tutorials/resonance.qmd); [Palace 200 nm historical reference](history/simplepad-eigenmode-200nm.qmd) | Mode frequencies and returned mode report |
| Energy participation | [HFSS EPR tutorial](tutorials/resonance-epr.qmd); [Palace 200 nm historical reference](history/simplepad-epr-200nm.qmd) | Surface, bulk and junction participation by mode |
| Driven S-parameters | [HFSS Modal or Terminal](tutorials/scattering.qmd) | Two-port response with the selected port family |
| Transmission-line parameters | [AEDT Q2D](tutorials/transmission-line.qmd) | Per-length C, G, L and R matrices |

## Prepare a model and read its return

Follow the selected tutorial’s environment steps first; the [general installation guide](course/installation.qmd) is supplementary. Then select explicit geometry, materials, conductors and ports for your physical question. The [model and materials reference](reference.qmd#model-materials) and [conductors and ports reference](reference.qmd#conductors-ports) explain those choices. Use [returned results](course/returned-results.qmd) to keep the returned quantity, units, mode or conductor identity, and solver status together.

## Explore larger examples {#public-inputs}

Choose an Xmon model, finite-ground CPW, or CPW cross-section example to match the subject of your study.

| Example group | Use |
|---|---|
| [Xmon model](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon) | Palace electrostatic/Eigenmode and Xmon source studies |
| [Finite-ground CPW](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | HFSS Eigenmode/Driven and historical Q3D GDS input |
| [CPW cross-section](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9/notebooks/src/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround) | Q2D rectangles and conductor groups |

::: {.callout-note title="Source revision" collapse="true"}
All three source groups use public OrPen SC PDK revision [`35b4dc1`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/35b4dc1cdd3f921badcac2fe57a98366315ae8d9), which declares OrPen `0.1.0` and GDSFactory 9.48.x. Example dimensions and presets are model inputs. For current SCGSim requests, follow the relevant tutorial and API references.
:::
